cells.tense: The support is moving now, clean and measured, with the pen in today's hand.
cells.act: choose which star to steer by and steer
cells.ask: Pick a heading for the support that matters most, chosen from wanting it rather than working it out, and move it a single step. No surveying the rest.
cells.core:
The strength is going out and coming back. Something of yours is landing with the people near you, and it is not being spent just because it left your hands. You can watch it arrive and see it carried onward, which is why offering it does not scare you the way it once did. What you cultivate reaches a point of use, and the use is visible.

That is the balanced case, and the balance is not the whole of it. What wants feeding next is direction: the support is generous but it has no single heading. One step this week, along a line you chose on purpose, and then hold your hand. Do not turn it into a project. Name where a heading would come from in your own life, and take it. The rest of the support can keep flowing while you do.
cells.sheetLine: The strength is shared and visible, and it wants one heading.

cells.tense: You are reading the ledger before the moment arrives, seeing who will owe what before anyone has asked.
cells.act: keep your own count of what is owed, and pay it
cells.ask: For a week, keep track only of what you owe — nothing of what you are owed — and settle your part without asking anyone else to settle theirs.
cells.core:
Support has turned into fairness, and the fairness has turned into a running account. You are already there with the calculator before the room has asked: who is short, who should step up, what you will do if they do not. The check is real, and it is costing the connection it was supposed to guard. People can feel the scale sitting between you and them.

Fixing this means going private with the fairness instead of public. Keep track only of what you owe and settle it, without balancing anyone else's account and without telling them what their share is. You will still know. Say a plain sentence when something is owed to you, once, and then let the matter close. What you owe is the only part that stays yours to discharge.
cells.sheetLine: The accounting has outpaced the moment.

cells.tense: Something ended, and the strength that used to go out now sits in a place it has left.
cells.act: engage the hard part on purpose and see what holds
cells.ask: Take up a hard piece of this that you have been avoiding, and find which part of your care is committed and which was only the form.
cells.core:
You are standing at a threshold that closed behind you. The support used to leave your hands easily; now it stays. The people are there, and you are not reaching toward them, and the whole arrangement feels finished. You may not be able to say when it stopped. You do not have to.

A plant comes back through its roots, not through force. Take up a hard piece of this on purpose, small and on your own terms, and find which part of your care is committed and which was only the form. What holds, you keep. What does not hold, you drop the approach and not the commitment. The connection may return through the part of you that still wants it, in its own time, after you have stopped trying to force the threshold.
cells.sheetLine: The care is still there and the reach has not come back.

cells.tense: The alignment is already at work between you and them, and your own name for it is being easy.
cells.act: turn toward the one direction and stop surveying
cells.ask: Face a single direction in this connection instead of surveying it — no comparing, no checking where the options stand — and see days later what moved without your management.
cells.core:
The connection is in good order, and the order is not your doing. You would say the two of you just fit, that conversation is easy, that nothing is required. Something is moving a freely given strength between you, and it is not the result of you tending it. What is at work is a heading, and you have been treating it as coincidence. People near you can feel the difference.

Acknowledge the pull rather than the outcome. Face a single direction in this connection instead of surveying it — no comparing, no checking where the options stand — and see days later what moved without your management. You are not asked to announce anything. Knowing that a heading was yours is the whole act, and the strength stays one you can feel in your own hand.
cells.sheetLine: The alignment is real, and you have been treating it as good luck.
